name: presenter
description: Bisque's open-source skills. Quickly turn a design doc, a pull request, a website, or anything your agent has in its context into a watchable presentation you can share. Includes the present skill, which makes and publishes one; the watch skill, which reads a published presentation so an agent can summarize or answer questions about it; and the video skill, which renders one to an MP4 on a Mac. Free and unlimited — nothing is billed per word.
